mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TBL_BUG bu JOIN TBL_BUG_CRITERION cir on BU.BUGID=CIR.BUGID WHERE 1=1 and ( BUGDEPARTMENT in (select ORGID from TBL_ORGANIZATION where 1=1 and ORGTYPE=0 start with fatherorgid=#{orgid} connect by prior fatherorgid=ORGID ) or BUGDEPARTMENT=#{orgid}) AND ${ew.sqlSegment}

SELECT BU.BUGNUMBER, c.BUGCRILEVEL, TO_CHAR(BU.DISCOVERTIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') as DISCOVERTIME, BU.DISCOVERPERSON, BU.BUGSOURCE, BU.BUGPROPERTY, ( SELECT ORGNAME FROM TBL_ORGANIZATION org WHERE 1 = 1 AND ORGTYPE != 0 AND orgtype < 100 START WITH ORGID = BU.BUGDEPARTMENT CONNECT BY PRIOR FATHERORGID = ORGID AND ROWNUM = 1) ORGS, o.ORGNAME, BU.NEEDREFORM, BU.BUSINESSDESCRIPTION, bu.bugdescripte FROM TBL_BUG bu LEFT JOIN TBL_BUG_CRITERION cir on BU.BUGID=CIR.BUGID left join TBL_BUGCRITERION c on cir.BUGCRIID = c.BUGCRIID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION O ON BU.BUGDEPARTMENT = O.ORGID WHERE (BUGDEPARTMENT in (select ORGID from TBL_ORGANIZATION where 1=1 and ORGTYPE=0 start with fatherorgid=#{orgid} connect by prior fatherorgid=ORGID) or BUGDEPARTMENT=#{orgid}) and BU.BUGBYSYSTEM like #{type} ORDER BY BU.BUGID desc
